_comment: Bug regression template. Use this to generate targeted test cases for specific known bugs.
_usage: Copy this file, rename it (e.g. bugs-sprint-22.json), fill in the bugs array, then run: python main.py --config configs/bugs-sprint-22.json
_run_name_comment: Replace {{SPRINT_OR_DATE}} with sprint number or date. Example: Sprint-22 or Mar-2026.
_mode_comment: Focused mode — generates test cases specifically designed to reproduce and verify bug fixes.

bugs._jira_key_comment: Jira issue key of the bug. Example: EXAMPLE-2646
bugs.title: {{BUG_TITLE}}
bugs._title_comment: Full bug title copied from Jira.
bugs._priority_comment: Bug priority: critical | high | medium | low
bugs._module_comment: Which EXAMPLE module this bug is in. Example: Orders, Investigator, Search
bugs._affected_file_comment: Path to the source file that contains the bug fix. Relative to repo root.
bugs._bug_description_comment: Plain English: what goes wrong? Example: Returns 404 instead of 302 for unauthenticated users.
bugs._steps_to_reproduce_comment: Exact steps to reproduce the bug. Copy from Jira if available.
bugs._expected_behavior_comment: What the correct behavior should be after the fix.
bugs._actual_behavior_comment: What the buggy behavior is. Used to write the 'before fix' negative test.
bugs._test_data_required_comment: Example: 'Need a user without session cookie' or 'Need work request at child location'.

bugs._example: Filled example for EXAMPLE-2646 — delete before use
bugs.title: Investigator/Home/Index returns 404 instead of 302 for unauthenticated requests
bugs.bug_description: When an unauthenticated user navigates to /Investigator/Home/Index, the server returns HTTP 404 Not Found instead of HTTP 302 redirect to /Account/Login.
steps_to_reproduce: Log out of EXAMPLE completely (clear session cookie)
bugs.actual_behavior: HTTP 404 Not Found — page not found error shown
bugs.test_data_required: Unauthenticated browser session (clear cookies or use incognito)

bugs._example: Filled example for EXAMPLE-2647 — delete before use
bugs.title: Search/Execute returns 500 when session cookie is missing
bugs.bug_description: POST to /Search/Execute returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when the session session cookie is missing. Should return 302 redirect to login.
steps_to_reproduce: Open browser DevTools → Application tab → delete session cookie
POST to /Search/Execute?isTriggerSearch=true with valid search body

_test_type_filter_comment: Bug regression always uses regression type.
_generate_negative_tests_comment: Also generate 'negative' tests that CONFIRM the bug exists (before-fix verification).
_dry_run_comment: Always preview first. Set to false to push to Jira.
_push_to_xray_comment: Set to true to push to Xray after generation.
_jira_labels_comment: Labels applied to all bug regression test cases in Jira.
_link_to_bug_comment: If true, each generated test case will be linked to its source bug in Jira (requires Xray API).
_test_environment_comment: RC environment URL where bugs were found and must be verified.
